# Weft 1.0.61
- Save private claim-token files outside project checkouts so agents can resume their workspace reservation after an app or Mac restart. Successful claims return the file path; release and reviewed recovery retire it. - Refresh claim status after runtime inspection so a workspace claimed during inspection is shown as held. - Distinguish repository and connection operations in progress from another task’s workspace claim across setup, agent linking and connection controls. - Retain the stacked pull-request base selection and changed-file, package-related test scoping introduced in 1.0.60.
Existing claims whose tokens were already lost still require reviewed recovery. Claims do not expire automatically.
Existing Beta features remain off by default in **Settings → Preview → Beta features**. This update preserves existing projects, worktrees, approvals and connections.
Requires macOS 26 or later and Apple silicon. Versions through 1.0.52 require one manual installation to enable in-app updates.
